title: 36 Hours in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
abstract: Vietnam’s biggest city is transforming with new highrises, bars and boutiques, but still offers old-world charm and chaotic fun.

title: 36 Hours in Prague
abstract: The Czech capital is finding a new balance between preserving its past and embracing the future.

title: 36 Hours in Palermo, Italy
abstract: Street food and medieval churches meet natural wine bars and compelling new museums in Sicily’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in Cartagena, Colombia
abstract: With a limonada de coco in hand, explore two walkable neighborhoods over a weekend in this coastal Colombian city.

title: 36 Hours in Amsterdam
abstract: The Dutch capital is busier and more sanitized than you remember, but visitors can find glimpses of Amsterdam where the city’s creative spirit is still brimming.
